page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-384-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 384 dedicated virtual CPUs and a total memory capacity of 3024.0 GB, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. While the local storage size parameter is listed as None, the system configuration includes 24 Local SSDs as part of its storage-optimized design. There are no GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

With 384 dedicated vCPUs and over 3 TB of system memory, this instance provides high resource density for workloads requiring massive parallel processing and substantial memory footprints. Because benchmark data is currently unavailable for this specific instance type, performance characteristics must be evaluated based on its raw hardware profile. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated compute cores and memory resources makes it suitable for consolidating large-scale enterprise workloads, though the lack of GPU acceleration limits its utility for hardware-accelerated machine learning tasks.

The z4d-highmem-384-standardlssd is designed for memory-intensive and storage-optimized workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale relational and non-relational databases, in-memory data analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and high-throughput data warehousing. The combination of 384 dedicated vCPUs and 3024.0 GB of RAM also makes it a viable candidate for heavy ETL pipelines and large-scale virtualization hosts.
